original_content_full: The paper "FERMIUM: A Framework for Real-time Procedural Point Cloud Animation and Morphing" by Ole Wegen, Florence Böttger, Jürgen Döllner, and Matthias Trapp was accepted for publication and presentation at the 26th International Symposium on Vision, Modeling, and Visualization (VMV 2021). The symposium will take place as virtual-only event September 27-28, 2021 at the Faculty of Computer Science of the Technische Universität Dresden, Germany.
